procedure.description: A coded value specifying the procedure used to process the specimen.

additive.description: Material used in the processing step.

timeDateTime.description: A record of the time or period when the specimen processing occurred.  For example the time of sample fixation or the period of time the sample was in formalin.

timePeriod.description: A record of the time or period when the specimen processing occurred.  For example the time of sample fixation or the period of time the sample was in formalin.
